newsitem.title: USA: Trinitech sets shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Trinitech sets shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Trinitech Systems Inc on Tuesday said it has adopted a stockholder rights plan designed to protect stockholders from various takeover tactics.

The company has declared a dividend granting to its stockholders the right to purchase for each common share one one-hundredth of a share of a series of preferred stock that will be established by the Company, at a price of $40 for each one-hundredth of a Preference Share.
The rights will be issued on July 31, 1997 or shortly thereafter, to shareholders on that date.
The rights become exercisable after any person or group becomes the beneficial owner of 20 percent or more of the company's common stock.
